nodes.name: finalize.rs
nodes.summary: Shared finalization helpers for human-in-the-loop interactions (questions, permissions, mode switches, secrets), providing a cancellable async wait helper and a unified event that records how an interaction concluded.

nodes.name: InteractionOutcome
nodes.summary: Enum of outcome variants (Responded/Cancelled/TimedOut/AutoResponded/Dropped) used to classify how an interaction ended.

nodes.name: AutoTimeoutAction
nodes.summary: Enum describing what happens when an auto-timeout policy expires (Respond with default vs Report).

nodes.name: AutoTimeoutPolicy
nodes.summary: Struct pairing a timeout Duration with an AutoTimeoutAction, used to configure auto-resolution behavior.

nodes.name: FinalizedStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of terminal statuses (Answered/Cancelled/TimedOut/Rejected) with an as_str accessor for serialization.

nodes.name: await_with_cancel
nodes.summary: Generic async helper that races a future against a cancellation flag/channel, returning early if cancellation is signaled.

nodes.name: finalize_interaction_event
nodes.summary: Central function called by all interaction managers (questions, permissions, mode switches, secrets) to emit a standardized completion event/log entry once an interaction resolves.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the interaction subsystem, declaring and re-exporting the finalize, mode_switch, permission, permission_rules, plan_approval, presence_policy, presence_state, profile_state, question, and secret_broker submodules that together implement human-in-the-loop interaction handling.

nodes.name: mode_switch.rs
nodes.summary: Manages pending agent-mode-switch requests, letting the backend ask the user to approve switching interaction modes and tracking cancellable, timeout-driven auto-resolution of those requests.

nodes.name: ModeSwitchChoice
nodes.summary: Enum of user responses to a mode-switch prompt (Switch/Skip) with a from_wire parser.

nodes.name: ModeSwitchManager
nodes.summary: Core manager holding pending mode-switch requests and cancellation state; exposes ask/respond/auto-resolve/cancel operations.

nodes.name: from_wire
nodes.summary: Parses a wire-format string into a ModeSwitchChoice enum value.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: Registers a new pending mode-switch request and returns a receiver the caller awaits for the user's decision.

nodes.name: respond
nodes.summary: Resolves a pending mode-switch request with the user's choice and finalizes the interaction event.

nodes.name: auto_resolve_after_timeout
nodes.summary: Spawns a watcher that auto-resolves a pending mode-switch request once its timeout elapses.

nodes.name: cancel_pending
nodes.summary: Cancels a pending mode-switch request, notifying the waiting caller and recording the cancellation outcome.

nodes.name: permission.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the agent's tool-permission approval flow, tracking pending permission prompts per session, evaluating always-allow rules, and persisting granted permissions to a per-workspace store.

nodes.name: PermissionResponse
nodes.summary: Enum of user permission decisions (Allow/Deny/AlwaysAllow) with a from_wire parser.

nodes.name: AgentPermissionManager
nodes.summary: Central manager tracking pending permission requests, session-scoped rules, and a persistent always-allow rule store per workspace.

nodes.name: from_wire
nodes.summary: Parses a wire-format permission response string into a PermissionResponse enum value.

nodes.name: for_agent_with_cancel_flag
nodes.summary: Constructs an AgentPermissionManager scoped to an agent/session with a shared cancellation flag and default persistent store.

nodes.name: set_workspace
nodes.summary: Loads the persistent PermissionStore for a given workspace path and swaps it into the manager.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a new pending permission request awaiting the user's decision.

nodes.name: respond
nodes.summary: Resolves a pending permission request, optionally persists an always-allow rule, and finalizes the interaction event.

nodes.name: cancel_pending
nodes.summary: Cancels a pending permission request and records the cancellation as a finalized interaction event.

nodes.name: build_rule
nodes.summary: Builds a PermissionRule from a tool name and call parameters for always-allow matching.

nodes.name: add_always_allowed
nodes.summary: Adds a new always-allow rule to the session's rule set.

nodes.name: check_always_allowed
nodes.summary: Checks whether a tool call matches an existing always-allow rule.

nodes.name: request_permission
nodes.summary: High-level entry point that checks always-allow rules first, then falls back to prompting the user and awaiting their response with cancellation support.

nodes.name: permission_rules.rs
nodes.summary: Defines glob-style permission rules and a JSON-backed PermissionStore for persisting per-workspace always-allow decisions used by the tool-permission approval flow.

nodes.name: PermissionRule
nodes.summary: Represents a single always-allow rule (tool + matcher pattern) with parsing and glob-based matching logic.

nodes.name: PermissionStore
nodes.summary: JSON file-backed store of allow/deny PermissionRules for a workspace, with load/save/query operations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a PermissionRule from a tool name and raw pattern string.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a raw permission-rule string (tool:pattern format) into a PermissionRule.

nodes.name: matches
nodes.summary: Tests whether a tool call's matchable content satisfies this rule's pattern.

nodes.name: extract_matchable_content
nodes.summary: Extracts the string content from tool-call parameters that should be matched against permission rule patterns.

nodes.name: glob_match
nodes.summary: Implements simple glob-style wildcard matching between a pattern and candidate string.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads the PermissionStore's allow/deny rules from the workspace's permissions.json file, tolerating missing/corrupt files.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Persists the current allow/deny rules to the workspace's permissions.json file.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the agent's plan-approval workflow: tracking a pending plan awaiting user approval, auto-approving after a deadline, persisting/rehydrating plan state to SQLite across restarts, and reconciling orphaned or superseded plan submissions.

nodes.name: PlanResolution
nodes.summary: Enum describing how a plan was resolved (Approved/Rejected/Superseded/Orphaned) with UI-facing status/label helpers.

nodes.name: PendingPlanApproval
nodes.summary: DTO holding a pending plan's session/tool-call identifiers, path, title, and content, convertible to/from its DB row representation.

nodes.name: PlanApprovalManager
nodes.summary: Core manager tracking the single pending plan approval, exposing mark_ready/take/reject/rehydrate operations and pushing UI events via the Tauri app handle.

nodes.name: PlanApprovalCardStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of UI card statuses (Pending/Archived/Approved/Cancelled) derived from a PlanResolution.

nodes.name: OrphanCreatePlanSubmission
nodes.summary: Represents a create-plan tool submission that lost its pending-approval record, used during startup repair.

nodes.name: resolve_pending
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently pending plan (approve/reject/supersede), updates persistence, and returns the resolution outcome.

nodes.name: to_row
nodes.summary: Converts a PendingPlanApproval into its SQLite row representation.

nodes.name: from_row
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a PendingPlanApproval from a stored SQLite row.

nodes.name: push_plan_approval_event
nodes.summary: Emits a plan-approval event to the frontend via the Tauri app handle.

nodes.name: mark_ready
nodes.summary: Registers a newly created plan as pending approval, persists it, and schedules the auto-approve watcher.

nodes.name: rehydrate_from_db
nodes.summary: Restores in-memory pending-plan state from the SQLite-backed store on startup/reconnect.

nodes.name: build_plan_approval_event
nodes.summary: Constructs the frontend-facing plan-approval event payload from manager state.

nodes.name: spawn_auto_approve_watcher
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task that auto-approves the pending plan once its deadline elapses, unless cancelled first.

nodes.name: persist_blocking
nodes.summary: Runs a blocking SQLite persistence operation on a background thread.

nodes.name: load_snapshot_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted plan-approval snapshot for a given session from the database.

nodes.name: gc_orphaned_pending_plans
nodes.summary: Garbage-collects pending plan rows in the database that no longer correspond to a live session.

nodes.name: repair_orphaned_create_plan_submissions
nodes.summary: Scans for create-plan submissions missing a pending-approval record and repairs them asynchronously.

nodes.name: repair_orphaned_create_plan_submissions_sync
nodes.summary: Synchronous implementation that reconciles orphaned create-plan tool submissions with the pending-approval store.

nodes.name: find_existing_plan_path
nodes.summary: Looks up an existing plan file path associated with a session/tool call during repair.

nodes.name: session_row_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a session row still exists in the database, used to identify orphaned plan rows.
